data.title: bn-12ta + bn-16g3: Kani codec proofs, canonical varint, wrapping timestamp deltas

data.reason: Canonical varint + wrapping deltas correct; 94 cache tests pass. Non-blocking: old release builds (no overflow-checks) already wrapped deltas, so compat holds but the 'no such caches exist' premise is wrong; clock/text.rs decode_varint_u64 is non-canonical and drops bits at shift 63 (checked_shl checks only the shift); kani.sh exits 0 when no harnesses are found (e.g. run outside repo root).
Re-LGTM after kani.sh empty-harness fix (reviewer suggestion). Verified: fails with rc=1 outside repo root, runs normally inside.
